en.p: For two positive numbers $a$, $p$, let $\mathrm{F_1}$ be the focus of the parabola $(y-a)^2=4px$, and $\mathrm{F_2}$ the focus of the parabola $y^2=-4x$. When P, Q are the points where segment $\mathrm{F_1F_2}$ meets the two parabolas, respectively, $\overline{\mathrm{F_1F_2}}=3$ and $\overline{\mathrm{PQ}}=1$. What is the value of $a^2+p^2$? [4 points]
